brief: Seraphim was a monk and priest of the Russian Church who became, after many years in solitude, a remarkable spiritual director (staretz), with great gifts of healing and insight. He was born in 1759. His life, marked by a radiant joy, was centred on the “prayer of the heart”, or “Jesus prayer”, an unceasing communion with Jesus. He stressed the need to draw Jesus into one’s heart, and that “every soul is brought to life by the Holy Spirit.” The whole aim of the Christian life he defined as the “acquisition of the gifts of the Holy Spirit and of the Holy Spirit himself”. He died in 1833.
